domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains columns typical of retail transactional data: InvoiceNo (transaction identifier), StockCode and Description (product details), Quantity and UnitPrice (line-item pricing), InvoiceDate (transaction timestamp), CustomerID (buyer identifier), and Country (geographic market). The presence of these fields strongly suggests an e-commerce or retail sales domain.

kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of all sales (Quantity * UnitPrice) across the dataset, representing the business's gross revenue.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is a fundamental KPI for retail businesses, providing a single summary metric of overall performance. A 'card' visual is ideal for displaying this single value.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) grouped by Country, identifying top revenue-generating markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Revenue by country is critical for understanding geographic performance. A bar chart effectively compares revenue across the low-cardinality 'Country' dimension.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) aggregated by month to analyze sales trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Tracking revenue over time is essential for identifying seasonality and growth patterns. A line chart is the best visual for displaying trends across the 'InvoiceDate' dimension.

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Average revenue per invoice (total revenue divided by number of unique invoices), measuring customer spending per transaction.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS avg_order_value FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: AOV is a key retail metric for understanding customer purchasing behavior. A 'card' visual is appropriate for this single summary value.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Products by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Top 10 products (StockCode and Description) ranked by total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice), identifying best-selling items.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT StockCode, Description, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY StockCode, Description ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: Identifying top-performing products helps prioritize inventory and marketing efforts. A table is suitable for displaying the multi-column breakdown (StockCode, Description, and revenue) with ranked results.
